name: attr_chain_methods
code:
class N:
    def __init__(self, v, nx=None):
        self.v = v
        self.nx = nx
        self.items = []
    def get(self):
        return self.v
    def child(self):
        return self.nx
a = N(1)
b = N(2, a)
c = N(3, b)
print(c.nx.nx.get())
c.nx.nx.items.append(7)
print(a.items)
print(c.nx.nx.items[0])
print(len(c.nx.nx.items))
print(c.child().nx.v)
print(c.child().child().v)
print(c.nx.child().v)

name: attr_chain_mixed_ops
code:
class Box:
    def __init__(self, v):
        self.inner = Inner(v)
class Inner:
    def __init__(self, v):
        self.v = v
        self.tag = 't' + str(v)
b = Box(42)
print(b.inner.v)
print(b.inner.tag)
print(b.inner.v - 2)
print(b.inner.v / 2)
print(str(b.inner.v) + '!')
print(b.inner.v % 5)
b.inner.v -= 2
print(b.inner.v)
b.inner.tag += '!'
print(b.inner.tag)
